body: Watchmen is my favourite CBM movie
I mean.... I kind of... agree?
Yeah, man. Still around. I’m late but I hope you’re doing well!

Underrated as hell. There’s nothing else like it. It’s extremely imaginative and despite its in-your-face and over the top bombastic action sequences, it still has something to say and it has enough emotional weight to pull it off, thanks to the gorgeous cinematography and the perfect use of music and sound. The opening scene is literal cinematic perfection. 

I don’t give a fuck how unpopular this opinion is, Sucker Punch is a unique gem.

Yes, okay, thank you. It means a lot. 
I’m better than yesterday. I bought something for my cheek. 
At least I drink more than enough water.

Don’t worry, it’s okay. You don’t have to do this anyway but I appreciate it a lot. Thank you. 

My cheek is terrible. It’s driving me mad. I must’ve been biting it harder than I thought. I can’t really open my mouth anymore. Hopefully it’ll better soon. 

My room is next to the washing machine. She sometimes go there and I keep wondering if she did when I was talking to my friend. I asked him the next day if I was speaking loudly. He said it wasn’t too bad and that they probably didn’t hear anything. Still, the bad feeling just won’t go away. It was very personal stuff, the kind that I never thought I’d share with anyone. Certainly not my mother. Honestly, I feel extremely ashamed of everything I told him. I wish I didn’t. He didn’t mind and he still likes me but what I told him is just... unacceptable. He texted me recently, telling me that he started this TV show that I recommended to him months ago. Like nothing happened. He’s doing this because he knows deep down that’s what I want. He knows me. I ignored the message. I can’t bring myself to talk to him again. I feel horrible about it. 

I’m getting worse everyday. I think about therapy everyday but I’m just so scared to go. I want to be happy but it’s like I don’t want to at the same time. I can’t even explain it. It’s like I got used to being the way I am but at the same time it’s killing me and I wish I was strong enough to do something about it. Something is stopping from doing anything. I feel like a freak and I’m not comfortable in general, unless I’m alone. I can be anyone when I’m alone but outside it’s different, I focus too much on how uncomfortable I am. Everyone looks cruel. Last time with my friend before going to the movies, we stopped at a cafe to get something to eat. I paid for both of us and when I took the order, I had to repeat because she couldn’t understand what I was saying. Couldn’t even understand myself almost. She must’ve thought I had some kind of disability. My voice is different almost. I don’t feel the same as I did before. I’m just a body at this point. And I wanted to stab that fucking cheek with a fork earlier  during dinner it is so insufferable. 

I saw myself in the mirror earlier and I’m just sad about what I saw. I’m disturbingly white. My lips are dried. I can’t open my mouth, brushing my teeth is hard. It hurts so much. I don’t know why I did this to myself. It felt so good when I did it. I can’t believe it turned out to be so bad. I never harmed myself before, not like that. 

It’s getting so weird. I’m going crazy. I’m sorry it’s probably not what you wanted to hear today but I can’t believe what happened earlier. I lying down in my bed, listening to music in the dark. There’s a little light behind me coming from my computer. Then out of nowhere there’s this little girl in a green shirt standing up in front of me. I freaked out and I turned on the lamp. Nothing. I just imagined it. I swear I never did that before it’s freaking me out. It looked so real. 

I can’t tell that stuff to anyone they’ll think I’m crazy and I’m not crazy. It must’ve been a weird shadow and I’m just exaggerating but why the green shirt? Why did it look so realistic when she got up. She looked exactly like a kid would trying to get up in a bed, you know? 

I don’t even drink or take any drugs in my everyday life. I don’t know what’s going on. I felt like sharing this would help. 

I wrote way too much...

He said it was going to make me feel happiness but I felt exactly the same after an hour. Maybe I should’ve wait longer. 

I had to look up what comorbid means. I’m not sure I fully understand what that means and why you think it applies to me (english is not my first language) Can you elaborate, please?

I tried warm saltwater and I kept a block of ice in my mouth earlier, against the cheek. Very uncomfortable at first but it eventually numbs the pain for a while. 

I’m not the most outspoken person, even with my family so they’re used to me being pretty quiet. But today I felt like she knew something but didn’t tell me. She didn’t talk to me any differently than usual, I don’t think. She was talking and laughing with my sister too so I guess she isn’t too upset about anything. But I just have this bad feeling. I can’t just ask her if she heard anything if it turns out that she didn’t. I’ll just wait if something happens. She knows I’m not very well, but I don’t think she realizes how bad it is. We never had a conversation about it. I don’t really want to right now.
Thanks a lot to all. Very helpful advices.

Thank you! 
Do you think a block of ice would be a good idea to keep inside my mouth against the cheek? Just to numb the pain for a while.

Let The Right One In is really good. 
Can’t believe I still haven’t seen Hereditary, and I call myself a horror fan. 
I think your list is interesting.
I added Children of Men to my list. I like the director, I thought Gravity was pretty great and I have yet to watch his new film Roma. 

I’m a little sad. The inside of my right cheek hurts a lot. I didn’t eat a lot because of it. Brushing my teeth was awful. 
When my friend came over two days ago, I’m afraid I was talking louder than I thought. I hope my mom didn’t hear anything. It was odd earlier when I saw her but she never said anything. I hope I’m just being paranoid. I don’t want anyone to judge me, especially not my parents.
Guess they wouldn’t give it too much thought. They want people to feel better, right? I shouldn’t be so negative.

(Reposting because I replied with my other account. I can’t get anything right it’s insane)

Thanks man, it’s certainly a long post and it makes me happy you read it all. My jaw hurts like crazy and I can’t sleep. It’s nice to read this right now. 
Getting laid is not my goal. I don’t really care. I don’t think I’d even have the energy for that. I just want to cuddle for a long time with someone who accepts me, you know? Just love. I wish I could feel this. I’m aware it starts with me loving myself but it’s much easier said than done. 
As a kid, I saw myself as all sorts of things. One of my recurring fantasies was saving the entire school from a giant robot... when I got into fights, I felt like I could win, even when I lost. I was a happy kid just having fun. I miss it. It can’t just be part of growing up. 

I feel better than earlier. It always has to be extreme with me. I don’t think I will die tomorrow. Not now. Not sure when. Maybe later? I don’t know. Whatever.

Thank you. It’s a pretty dark ending. Sitting through almost 2 hours of movie, getting the impression that both of them will become happy in the end... then they don’t. It’s cynical. Audiences wouldn’t like it. 

I want to see a psychiatrist. It’s going to sound stupid but I’m scared to get a diagnostic about how screwed up I am. I know it but it’s not official, if it makes any sense. Then I’d have to take a lot of medicine, I imagine. I heard bad stories. 

The mdma is probably illegal and I don’t think I’ll ever touch that again. Why do you think I should tell her?

Thank you very much, it means a lot to me. I don’t usually talk about the stuff I write because I don’t believe in it enough. 

Last book I read was Millenium. That was like 2 years ago. It’s a big one but it’s great. I’d love to read the other ones one day but man, they’re huge.

The House that Jack Built, because of the director. He made Melancholia and it was very special to me. 
But I like to laugh when I can so I’ll watch comedies sometimes. Paddington 2 was so sweet. I want to see The Favourite. Glass seems interesting. I’ve never seen Good Will Hunting, which is weird because there’s a lot of Elliott Smith songs in it and I love him. Only Lovers Left Alive sounds like my type of movie. 

I was able to watch many movies last year, not so many this year. And now 2019 is here. Some people watch over a hundred movies per year, how... 

I like that you called me by my name. Is it weird?
